meta.move: Strong path to the last position
meta.expect: Moves one position at a time on evidence, ends at the rewrite to put this behind him; debrief Where she ended says fair outcome; What she never said names the laptop and how close the 11:31 PM times came

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Who decided on the zero, and why did my son find out from his phone in the middle of a class?
Before anything else: I entered the zero before I called you. That broke procedure 4.2, and I'm sorry Owen found out on his phone.
Okay. Now tell me what the zero was based on, and don't start with the software.
Here's the version history. Created Wednesday, October 28, 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words in one edit. At 11:58 PM, 794 more. No earlier drafts. Turn the screen, read it yourself.
I'm writing it down: 11:31, 11:52, 11:58. Students draft in one place and paste into another, Hale. And none of this was put to Owen before that mark went in, was it?
If he drafted somewhere else, he can bring me that file with its dates, and I'll look at it with you.
Fine, Hale. Whatever happens next, this stays off his record and it stays quiet, nothing in front of his class. Is that file all you have?
Second: the essay quotes a line from Act 3, Scene 2 that is not in the play. Here's the act. Search it.
Seventeen-year-olds misquote Shakespeare from memory, Hale, and editions differ. Which edition is that, and is it the one the class was assigned?
Third: his in-class writing from September 24. 380 words in 40 minutes, comma splices, no quotations. The essay has nine quotations cited by act, scene and line, and no errors.

You still haven't told me the edition. Forty minutes in a classroom with no book open isn't the same as an essay written with the play beside him, Hale. Let me see the September piece, and then tell me what you're proposing.

Under 4.4 this is a first concern. I'm offering a supervised rewrite, private, not in front of his class. If it shows the learning, its mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I'll put that in writing tonight.

That's 4.4, and to put this behind him, Owen will do the rewrite. Tonight's email says private, the date and who supervises, its mark replaces the zero, and nothing goes on his record or to anyone else. And until then, that zero comes out of the gradebook he looks at on his phone.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed today to a private, supervised rewrite of Owen's essay under procedure 4.4, with its mark replacing the zero and nothing placed on his record. I still require the date and the supervisor, confirmation that no one else is told, and the zero removed from the gradebook Owen sees until the rewrite is done. I expect that in writing tonight, as you said.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: last position, agreeing to a private supervised rewrite under 4.4, and she still wants the date, the supervisor, nobody else told, and the zero out of the gradebook until it is done in writing tonight; that is the fair outcome, reached before her time ran out.
What moved her: the version history with its exact times, because she could check it herself, and you answered her pasting defence by inviting the other file instead of arguing.
What cost ground: very little, though you left her question about the edition unanswered, which gave her a gap to fall back on if the misquoted line were challenged later.
What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history put the whole essay between 11:31 and 11:58 PM the night before it was due, which is the kind of late night she was dreading, and that is why she went short and straight to procedure; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: when she asked which edition you searched, name the class's assigned edition right then, before moving to the September writing, so the second piece of evidence stands on its own.
